newsitem.title: USA: US spot prods slide late day, gasoline diffs ease.
newsitem.headline: US spot prods slide late day, gasoline diffs ease.

text.p: U.S. spot product prices fell sharply Friday, led by the steep decline in February NYMEX futures as they reached expiration.
Gasoline differentials in both New York Harbor (NYH) and the U.S. Gulf (USG) eased during the day, though activity remained fairly thin, traders said.
"Just a lot of NYMEX watching going on today," one market player said.
No. 2 heat oil diffs eased slightly during early Friday trade, though nearby levels rebounded by the end of the day, according to traders.
NYH prompt conventional M5 unleaded barrels were talked between 1.50 and 2.00 cents under the screen, down nearly 1.0 cent on the day.

NYH prompt 87-octane reformulated diffs showed some weakness early in the day, with barrels changing hands at 0.40 cent over. However, that price had bounced back to 0.75 cent over the print late in the day.
USG conventional unleaded M4 material offered for delivery on the fourth cycle of the Colonial Pipeline at 2.40 cents under the screen, nearly even with both 5th and 6th cycle levels, traders said.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk + 1 212 859 1626
